external_collaboration.partner_name: ELIA (European League of Institutes of the Arts)
external_collaboration.evidence_quote: L'ENSAV La Cambre is a full member of ELIA (European League of Institutes of the Arts).

As an associate member of the Cumulus association, ENSAV La Cambre raises its voice internationally and contributes to a collective reflection on the reinvention of design schools in the 21st century.
ENCoRE is a network organisation of higher education institutions in the field of conservation-restoration.

external_collaboration.partner_name: University of Art and Design in Helsinki
external_collaboration.evidence_quote: Founded in 1990 on the initiative of the University of Art and Design in Helsinki, Finland, and the Royal College of Art, Cumulus is the leading international association for education and research in the field of design (and also art and media). It has 357 members in 66 countries. Cumulus has been recognised by UNESCO since 2011.
